title: Best Plush Toy (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were made by analyzing recommendations from CNET, Tom's Guide, Sleepopolis, Good Housekeeping, and Country Living. Products recommended by multiple sources were prioritized, but no single plush toy was recommended by more than one source in the provided excerpts.
assumptions: Prices are only included if explicitly stated in the source text. No current 2026 pricing is available in the sources.
